note: The pinned upstream checkout is never edited. Each entry below is a minimal capability hook applied as a require-cache overlay at load time (engine/lib/upstream/loader.cjs). 'upstreamSha256' pins the exact upstream file the overlay was written against, so drift is detectable. 'patch.anchorLine' + 'patch.insertLines' describe the same gate as a source edit; engine/scripts/generate-hook-patch.cjs renders them into hooks.patch as a review artifact. Entries that share a file and an anchorLine are merged into one hunk in manifest order.

patchShims.note: hooks.patch is a review artifact: it shows the gate that the require-cache overlay applies, against the pinned upstream file. It is not applied to the shipped tree.
